summary: Fade a failed London inside-bar break: after an inside bar whose mother is the first London 4h bar, price breaks the mother high/low then fails to hold and reverts back inside.
justification: A close-through of a locked first-London-4h mother after a true inside bar that fails to hold and re-closes inside is not a successful IB follow, not NR7, not a rolling N-bar failed-range, not a UTC-day ORB fail, and not an Asia-box London tag.
